name: gather-chop
notes: #353 AnimLab's third test clip: two work loops side by side at a bush and a tree. A gatherer on Gather (DollStyle.Pick) at a bush with 6 berries that drops one every 2 s while she picks (BushView's rule, sped up), and a woodcutter on Chop with the axe at a tree. Both face their target. Shows a hand tool's strike against a target (hits) next to a pick loop (no tool).
